posts.text: So much has happened in the last one month, the thesis is getting stronger though the evidence of turnaround is yet to be be seen. I follow a few X handles and am pleasantly surprised by how quickly new dealerships are opening. Many of the opened dealerships actually have good experience in running other 2W/4W dealership. I also observed Ola is not giving dealerships to those have dealerships from competition (understandable).
